name: Tammy Baldwin

caveats: Issues 9–10 come from a second poll (Rasmussen) because Marquette listed only eight issues; crime is tied at 5% with global conflicts and corruption.
Israel was scored on arms-sale disapproval votes; her stated position was conditioning aid, not blocking sales. Her Yea comes from news lists and her own statement, not senate.gov.
Her votes on roll calls 57, 372 and 644 are inferred from reports of unanimous Democratic votes. The roll call numbers come from the NH file, not a Baldwin-specific source.
H.R.1 (2025) funded border enforcement but was not counted for immigration, because her position was the 2024 bipartisan deal specifically.
